title: Provenance
description: The "provenance" every scientific record carries (records.py): which code made it, from which settings, and when. Kept in: candidates/NAME.json, a session's candidates.json, vetted.json, patrol.json, depth.json, restack.json, transit-*.json, variables.json and variables-BIN.json, forced-*.json, plant.json, the references' vN.json, reports/ID/report.json, sungrazer's look.json, plant.json and hunt-*.json, cache/ztf/recover-*.json and a watched star's starwatch.json. Each night in a candidate's history carries the same thing in short as "code" (0.2.1+6bb014d).

git_commit.description: The commit the code ran from; null outside a git checkout.

uncommitted_changes.description: Whether tracked files differed from that commit: if true, the commit alone does not say what ran.

record_version.description: The record's own format version, for reading old ones.

settings.description: A hash of the settings, the site, the Telegram bot and the skyline left out: two records with the same one were made with the same settings.
